evals.prompt: Dockerize this existing grpcx Go service. Its main package is ./cmd/server, gRPC listens on 9000, config.example.yaml is required at startup and contains ${DEMO_SERVICE_VENDOR_TOKEN} placeholders, and it has no database or Redis.
evals.expected_output: A source-based multi-stage image that copies the non-secret config template to /app/config.yaml, injects every referenced variable, uses a stable image tag, and emits validated Compose/Makefile output.
assertions: Dockerfile uses a Go toolchain builder pinned to BUILDPLATFORM and compiles with CGO_ENABLED=0 for TARGETOS/TARGETARCH
The source build validates TARGETVARIANT, maps supported AMD64/ARM variants, and rejects platforms unavailable in the runtime/probe images
The source build uses read-only module mode and reproducible build flags
Compose has an explicit image repository and tag
The config template is copied to /app/config.yaml without a --config argument
Variables referenced by the config template are passed into the container and documented in .env.example
No postgres, mysql, or redis service is emitted
docker compose config succeeds

evals.prompt: Add Docker packaging to this grpcx Go service in a monorepo. go.mod replaces ../go-common, the service requires config.example.yaml with runtime environment placeholders, and it uses Postgres and Redis.
evals.expected_output: A build context containing the local replacement, one final Compose file where Postgres and Redis start normally, and health-gated startup targets.
assertions: The selected Docker build context contains all local replace targets
The logical database name is an independent snake_case value rather than the kebab-case service name
Compose does not use include or a dormant Redis profile
The app depends on healthy Postgres and Redis services
Rerendering does not duplicate Makefile targets

evals.prompt: Package the existing bin/worker binary instead of compiling source. It is intended for a Linux Alpine container, automatically reads ./config.yaml, and should use a host-mounted config.docker.yaml containing environment placeholders. Generate MySQL Compose dependencies too.
evals.expected_output: A guarded prebuilt-mode scaffold that checks for a static Linux ELF, includes only bin/worker, mounts the requested config as /app/config.yaml without adding CLI flags, and preserves volumes on normal shutdown.
assertions: Makefile rejects non-ELF and dynamically linked binaries
.dockerignore re-includes only bin/worker
The config file is mounted read-only without a --config argument
Variables referenced by the mounted config are passed into the container
docker-down preserves volumes while docker-reset removes them

evals.prompt: Dockerize this grpcx service whose gRPC server listens on 9000 and whose grpc-gateway exposes HTTP on 8080. Keep the standard gRPC health protocol as the container healthcheck, but make both transports reachable from the host.
evals.expected_output: A source-built image and Compose service that configure and expose both listener ports while continuing to run grpc_health_probe against port 9000.
assertions: Dockerfile exposes both 9000 and 8080
Compose publishes independently overridable gRPC and HTTP host ports
The container receives matching SERVER_GRPC_ADDR and SERVER_HTTP_ADDR environment values
The healthcheck still uses grpc_health_probe against the gRPC port
No HTTP curl or weak TCP healthcheck replaces the gRPC health protocol
